# If you raise your rate and lose a client, do you come out ahead?

> Freelance rate increase calculator. List your clients, hours and rates, say how likely each is to leave, and see how many clients you can lose after a raise and still earn the same, the hours it frees and which clients make it a bad bet. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
